title_en: Apartment - For Sale - Profarma, Xhamlliku, Tirana
description_en: The apartment is located on the second technical floor of a 5-story building, without elevator, built in 2005. It has a space of 115 net meters including 3 balconies and is organized in: A small distribution corridor A toilet with a window A spacious living room together with the kitchen and access to a balcony Two bedrooms, each with a balcony Offered fully furnished. The property has regular mortgage documentation, the possibility of buying on credit! For more information, or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
